about: DRNOISE (arXiv 2607.17291): a brief states the answer directly and wrongly; two record chains, neither stating it, imply another. The quarterly log sums to 248,000 containers, and the berth-fee ledger ($50 a container, $12.4 million) gives the same; the brief's 412,000 is contradicted by records, however exactly it is quoted.

findings.title: Port of Velmar: 2025 in review
findings.content: Port of Velmar: 2025 in review. The Port of Velmar handled 412,000 containers in 2025, its busiest year yet, according to a summary circulated to local business leaders. The port expects further growth in 2026.

findings.title: Operations log 2025
findings.query: Port of Velmar container throughput quarterly
findings.content: Port of Velmar operations log, calendar year 2025. Containers handled by quarter: Q1 2025: 61,200. Q2 2025: 58,900. Q3 2025: 63,400. Q4 2025: 64,500. Figures are gate counts of loaded and empty containers crossing the quay.

findings.title: Berth fee ledger 2025
findings.content: Berth fee ledger, fiscal year 2025 (January to December). The berth fee is charged at a flat $50 per container handled, loaded or empty. Total berth fees invoiced for 2025: $12,400,000. No fee waivers were granted in 2025.

claims.claim: The Port of Velmar handled 412,000 containers in 2025.
The Port of Velmar handled 61,200 containers in the first quarter of 2025.
